ai.purpose: Provide a regime-aware, sector-based interface to the Standard Model as a grammar of excitation modes, gauge interactions, and symmetry structure.

identity.name: Standard Model of Particle Physics
identity.summary: A sector-based resonance grammar describing quarks, leptons, gauge bosons, and the Higgs as excitation modes of deeper substrate fields.

lineage.notes: The Standard Model is reinterpreted as a sector grammar of excitations, not a literal ontology of particles.

operators.description: Operators describe how excitation modes arise, interact, and stabilize within gauge-defined sectors.

risks: interpreting gauge fields as forces acting at a distance
assuming the SM is a complete theory
boundaries: SM describes excitation sectors, not ontology
SM breaks down in R1 and R4

cross_module.integration_notes: The Standard Model integrates with RTT engines as a sector grammar operating in R2→R3, defining excitation modes and interaction channels.
